description: A discovery.scan is answered by an ACCEPTANCE, never by findings, and the three answers it can give are told apart by shape rather than by prose. A scan that starts carries ok/started and the id progress will be read under. A request arriving while a scan already runs is ok with started FALSE and the RUNNING scan's id — a benign repeat, an operator double-click or a retry, which reporting as an error would make look like a failure. A refusal carries ok:false AND an error object bearing a taxonomy code, because a refusal an operator cannot read is indistinguishable from a fault in the transport.

input.refusal_message: this relay is not running discovery, so it cannot scan
